metadata.ffmpeg_version: 7.1-essentials_build-www.gyan.dev built with gcc 14.2.0 (Rev1, Built by MSYS2 project)

method: All241 frames technically decoded by scan_reel_video.py; read-only native extraction primitives. Actually viewed25 full-source checkpoints,5 head windows,15 hand/bag windows,61 foot-timing crops at4-frame spacing,15 full crowd/architecture checkpoints, and all120 selected-frame thumbnails across2 sheets. No normal-speed continuous playback.
recommended_selection_reason: Continuous full-person front walking with settled expression, leg alternation and visible commuters; avoids initial smile settling. This is a source candidate, not acceptance of a specific cut.
approval_scope: Assistant sampled U01 source QA permits an isolated join trial/user preview; does not approve perceived pace, audience appeal, identity consistency at every instant, joined film or publishing.

walk_and_native_timing.assessment: Continuous ordinary-to-somewhat-brisk walking candidate at the decoded native24fps; not running or stationary posing in the inspected gait sequence.
walk_and_native_timing.evidence: Every4-frame foot sequence shows repeated alternating swing, heel presentation and planted-foot phases rather than held poses. Coarse visible leading-foot changes are roughly0.5–0.7 seconds apart. No conspicuous prolonged double-foot airborne phase or static stop appears in these samples.
walk_and_native_timing.residual: Steps are narrow and sometimes cross the centerline; upper body is relatively composed and one hand holds the bag strap. This retains some posed/model-walk character. Exact world speed and improvement versus previous videos were not measured.
walk_and_native_timing.footfall_count_status: unknown; overlapping frontal ankles, shoe contact ambiguity and moving camera do not support an exact reliable count from sampled windows
walk_and_native_timing.rough_alternation_measurement_status: manual coarse observation from4-frame-spaced crops, not exact touchdown measurement

observations.camera: Subject remains near-frontal, centered and broadly similar head-to-shoe scale while pavement/background perspective changes and commuters move. This supports the intended front reverse-tracking appearance. It does not independently identify actual50mm optics or a physically measured camera speed.
observations.identity: M03 is recognizable and face remains readable in5 checkpoints; initial broad smile becomes a restrained closed-mouth expression. No abrupt sampled face substitution. Fine face fidelity at every instant is not established.
observations.outfit: Ivory long blazer worn open, white crewneck tee, navy/dark trousers, brown shoulder bag and black low-heeled shoes remain identifiable. Sleeves/hems and major garment contours remain coherent in inspected samples. No abrupt outfit swap or missing bag observed.
observations.hands_bag: Near hand consistently holds the bag strap; opposite arm makes a small natural swing. Bag stays at same side with modest flex. No conspicuous duplicated hand or severe strap/body penetration in15 detailed windows, but exact fingers are not exhaustively resolved.
observations.feet_contact: Alternating foot progression and shoe lifts are visible; no sampled severe teleport or gross slide requires rejecting this source. Plantar-lock/ground-slip of every stance cannot be certified from a moving-camera crop sequence. Narrow crossing steps remain a visible concern for commuter naturalness.
observations.crowd: Background is visibly populated and people change leg poses/positions; one back-facing commuter enters on frame-right and moves away. They do not occlude the main outfit in selected samples. Visible density is greater than a strict3–6 people at some checkpoints. Distant limbs/faces are small and synthetic-looking in places; no severe crowd merge/collapse or conspicuous main-person intersection in inspected boards.
observations.rigid_geometry: Building edges, window grids and pavement remain substantially straight in inspected checkpoints. No gross flowing wall/window or sudden geometric collapse. Perspective/background motion is compatible with reverse tracking but is not a full physical reconstruction.
observations.purpose_and_advertising: The front view, active pedestrian context and repeated forward steps are visible differences from the old three-quarter empty-background setup. Whether this reads as sufficiently decisive urban commuting or an attractive fashion advertisement requires actual normal-speed user review; it is not passed by the prompt wording.

join_risks: U01 remains frontal; switching to a90degree U02 profile can generate two facial/limb outlines even at similar person size. Match head/shoe positions and active stride phase before the requested18-frame overlap.
Background people and building lines will double in dissolve; do not treat population as inherently successful motion or conceal severe geometry errors with the transition.
Each retained120-frame source is5seconds, but a0.75second overlap consumes readable time. Keep the resulting pure-outfit duration explicit.
limitations: Sampled frames and chronological thumbnail sheets do not replace normal-speed continuous review.
All source frames decoded, but not all full-resolution frames manually inspected.
No exact step count, ground speed, specified lens or future IG performance was verified.
This report only reviews U01; U02 and their joined presentation remain separate gates.
